value.rationale: The original paper explicitly leaves open whether its all-parameter open dense plateau basin has full arclength measure, and the subsequent article establishes full measure only in special intervals. Establishing the full-parameter assertion settles a natural published gap in the typical dynamics of chaotic or zero-entropy invariant graphs and shows an absolute-continuity obstruction to invariant measures.
